title: Updated Plugin For Playing SE in Message Windows by Text created by Sasuke KANNAZUKI (Kadokawa)

posts.author: eyescreamsunday
posts.body:
I've successfully been able to modify the built in extra plugin "PlayMsgWndCharSeMZ.js" in RPG Maker MZ\dlc\BasicResources\plugins\launch folder that comes with the game. This allows to change from the original max of 5 SE's that must be defined in the plugin parameters, and now instead allows unlimited SE's as long as the files are in audio/se folder of the project, and can be called on by the filename in the message window text such as with "\SE[Filename1].
